translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Uyshapa duëñunman Jesucristo tincusicushgan
Mastapis Jesús nergan: “Uysha cunchaman puncupa mana yaycog cäga suwami caycan.
Cuncha puncupa yaycog cagmi isanga uyshapa ämun caycan.
Musyashgansinöpis cuncha puncuta quichapasquiptin uyshapa ämonga jutinpa jutinpa gayan uyshancunata.
Sayno gayashganta wiyashpanmi cunchapita uyshancuna yargayämun.
Lapan yargamurnami ämunpa guepanta aywayan, ämunta reguiyashpan.
Jäpa captenga manami gatiräyansu. Gatiräyänanpa trucanga gueshpirmi aywacuyan.”
Tincusiypa sayno Jesús yachasiptinmi saycho cag runacuna tantyayargansu sayno tincusir imata yachaycäsishgantapis.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Nogaga caycä uysha cuncha puncunömi.

Saymi cuncha puncupa uyshacuna yaycuyashganno nogata chasquicamag runacuna gloriaman yaycuyangapä. Uyshacuna ali guewacho weray weray cayashgannömi nogata chasquicamagcuna ali cawayta tariyangapä. Manarä shamuptë waquin runacuna lutanta yachasiyashpan puriyargan: ‘Nogatami Tayta Dios cachamash wilacuyninta wilacunäpä’ niyashpan. Sayno yachasiyaptinpis Tayta Diosman rasunpaypa yäracogcuna paycunata manami chasquicuyargansu.
Suwaga shamun suwacunanpä, wanusinanpä y ushacäsinanpämi. Nogami isanga shamushcä chasquicamag runacuna imayyagpis cushishla cawayänanpä.
“Saynöpis uyshanta ali miseg runanömi caycä. Uyshancunata wanuy caway misegnin salvashgannömi
nogapis uyshäcunata salvanä-raycu wanushäpä.
Pägu-raycula misipacog cäga löbu shamuptin gueshpirmi aywacun. Sayno aywacun ämun mana cashpanmi. Sauraga löbu gaticachaptin uyshacuna gueshpir mashipa mashirmi may-saypapis aywacuyan.
Sayno misipacog cäga uyshacuna elagaptinpis manami imapis gocunsu.
“Nogaga rasunpaypa ali miseg runanömi caycä. Saymi Taytäta reguishgäno y pay nogata reguimashganno nogapis uyshäcunata reguë y uyshäcunapis nogata reguiyäman. Saynöpis uyshäcuna-raycumi wanushäpä.

Manami caylachösu uyshäcuna caycan, sinöga may-saychöpis caycanmi. Paycunapis nishgäcunata wiyar cäsucayämangami. Saymi paycunatapis shuntamushä juc cunchalachöna cananpä. Saynöpis juclaylanami uysha misegnin cangapä.
“Taytäta cäsucur uyshäcuna-raycumi wanushä. Nircurnami cawarimushäpä. Sayno cäsucog captëmi Taytä cushicun.
Noga munayyogmi caycä wanunäpä y cawarimunäpäpis. Saymi quiquë mana munaptëga pipis wanusimanmansu. Sayno captinpis Taytä nimashgannömi wanushä y wanushgäpita cawarimushä.”
Jesús sayno parlaptinmi Israel runacunapa waquin autoridänincuna yarpäyargan rasun cagta nicashganta y waquin cagna yarpäyargan quiquinpa yarpaylanpita parlaycashganta.
Saymi waquin niyargan: “Payta supay löcutaycäsiptenga ¿imapätä cäsushunpis?”
Y waquin cagnami niyargan: “Supay löcutäsish captenga manami sayno parlanmansu. Saynöpis gapra runata manami aliyäsinmansu cargan.”
Runacuna Jesucristuta mana chasquicuyashgan
Diciembri quila templupa aniversariun fiestata rurayaptinmi templucho Jesús puriycargan Salomón nishgan alarcho.

Saychömi Israel runacunapa autoridänincuna Jesusta tapuyargan: “¿Imayyagtä shuyäshayqui rasun cagta wilayämänayquipä? Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashgayquita o mana cashgayquitapis jucla wilayämay.”
Sayno niyaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Maynami gamcunata wilashcä. Wilaptëpis manami criyiyämanquisu. Taytäpa munayninwan milagrucunata ruraycaptëpis manami criyiyämanquisu.
Gamcunaga criyiyämanquisu uyshäcuna mana cayashpayquimi.
“Uyshäcunami isanga pï cashgätapis tantyayashpan cäsucayäman. Saynöpis reguëmi uyshäcuna maygan maygan cashganta.
Nogata chasquicamashganpitami Tayta Diospa naupancho imayyagpis cawayangapä. Maquëcho captinnaga manami pipis guechumanganasu.
Maquëcho caycarga Taytäpa maquinchöpis caycanmi. Taytä lapanpäpis munayyog captinmi diablupis ni supaypis ni pipis paypa maquinpita jorgongasu.
Taytäwan nogaga juclaylami caycä.”
Sayno niptinmi say autoridäcuna Jesusta samgayta munayargan.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Gamcuna ricayashcanquimi asca milagrucunata Taytäpa munayninwan rurashgäta. ¿Sayno alita rurashgäpitacu samgayta munaycäyämanqui?”
Saymi say runacuna niyargan: “Manami alita rurashgayquipitasu samgayta munayä, sinöga runala caycar Dios-tucuycashgayquipitami.”
Sayno niyaptin Jesús nergan: “Tayta Diosninsipa palabrancho caynömi nican: ‘Gamcunaga dioscunami caycäyanqui.’

Musyayanquimi Tayta Diospa palabrancho lapanpis rasun cagla cashganta. Saymi Diospa wilacuyninta unay wiyagcunapä: ‘Gamcunaga dioscunami caycäyanqui’ nicaptenga ¿imanirtä: ‘Diospa surinmi caycä’ niptë yarpäyanqui lutanta nicashgäta? Quiquin Tayta Diosninsimi cay pasaman cachamash.
“Milagruta rurashgäcuna Taytä munashganno mana captenga ama criyiyämaysu: ‘Diospa surinmi caycä’ niptëpis.
Nishgäcunata mana criyirpis milagruta rurashgäcunata ricaycarga tantyacuyay Taytäwan say yarpayla cayashgäta.”
Sayno nishganpitami Jesusta yapay prësu sarisiyta munayargan. Sayno munayaptinpis Jesús saypita aywacorgan.
Nircurnami Jordán mayu simpanman Jesús cutergan. Saychömi naupata Juan Bautista bautizargan runacunata.
Jesús saycho cashganta musyarmi sayman asca runacuna aywayargan. Paycunami niyargan: “Ima milagrutapis Juan Bautista mana ruraptinpis Jesuspä lapan nishgancunaga rasun caglami caycan.”
Sayno nirmi asca runacuna criyiyargan Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta.

footnotes.text: Cay pasacho Jesús purinan wisanga runacunapa uyshan juc cunchalacho talucashmi punuyag. Saychömi uysha täpag runa puncuta quichapaptin uyshapa ämun uyshancunata jutinpa jutinpa gayag.
Jesucristo cawashgan wisan uysha misegcuna uyshancunata washargan atogpita, löbupita, leonpita, ösupitapis.
Dios cashganta unay runacuna pipäpis nergan mandag cashganpitami. Saypita masta musyanayquipä liyinqui Salmo 82.6.
